articles.title: Ten people confirmed dead in high-speed Spain train crash, local media report

articles.title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’

articles.title: Brazil’s largest lender becomes first bank to formalize crypto brokerage under new rules

articles.title: Musk's PAC lawyer runs in Texas House district that is home to billionaire's business interests
